build_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock: build a python module to create an EfficientGraphAttentionBlock with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization configs
run_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock_forward: run the EfficientGraphAttentionBlock forward pass with graph attention data, node features, and edge features
build_EfficientGraphAttention: build a python module to create an EfficientGraphAttention layer with multi-head self-attention and optional frequency embeddings
run_multi_head_self_attention: run the multi-head self-attention mechanism with optional frequency vector expansion and scaled dot product attention
build_FeedForwardNetwork: build a python module to create a FeedForwardNetwork with separate MLPs for node and edge features
